flow.name: support-agent-main-flow
flow.doc:name: Order Support Agent Flow
flow.doc:description: A2A agent: receives a task, lets OpenAI pick MCP tools, runs them, then returns the final answer

a2a:task-listener.doc:name: A2A Task Listener
a2a:task-listener.doc:description: Receives inbound A2A tasks for the Order Support Agent and returns the task response

ee:transform.doc:name: Extract task vars
ee:transform.doc:description: Extracts taskId, contextId and the user prompt text from the incoming A2A task

logger.doc:name: Flow start
logger.doc:description: Logs START tracePoint with the taskId and the user prompt
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'A2A task received', tracePoint: 'START'} ++ ({ taskId: vars.taskId, userPrompt: vars.userPrompt })]

ee:transform.doc:name: Build OpenAI request (with tools)
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds the first OpenAI request with the system prompt, user prompt and the four tool definitions

logger.doc:name: Before OpenAI call 1
logger.doc:description: Logs BEFORE_REQUEST before the first OpenAI call (tool selection)

http:request.doc:name: OpenAI tool selection
http:request.doc:description: Calls OpenAI Responses API to decide which support tools to invoke

logger.doc:name: After OpenAI call 1
logger.doc:description: Logs AFTER_REQUEST with the number of tool calls OpenAI requested

set-variable.doc:name: Set openaiResponseId
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the Responses API response id for the follow-up call with tool outputs

set-variable.doc:name: Set toolCalls
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the Responses API function_call output items for MCP execution

set-variable.doc:name: Set assistantText
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the direct assistant text when no tool calls are needed

set-variable.doc:name: Init toolResults
set-variable.doc:description: Initialises the empty list that will collect MCP tool results

choice.doc:name: Tool calls requested?
choice.doc:description: Branches on whether OpenAI requested any tool calls

when.doc:name: Tools requested
when.doc:description: Runs each requested MCP tool then asks OpenAI for the final answer

foreach.doc:name: For each tool call
foreach.doc:description: Iterates over every tool call OpenAI requested

set-variable.doc:name: Set currentCall
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the current tool call being processed

logger.doc:name: Before MCP tool call
logger.doc:description: Logs BEFORE_REQUEST with the name of the MCP tool about to be called

mcp:call-tool.doc:name: Call MCP tool
mcp:call-tool.doc:description: Invokes the named MCP tool on the TechWave Support MCP Server with the parsed arguments

ee:transform.doc:name: Extract MCP tool output
ee:transform.doc:description: Extracts the raw MCP text content for the OpenAI Responses function_call_output item

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var rawText = attributes.rawMcpResponse.contents[0].text default payload.contents[0].text default null --- rawText default write(payload, "application/json") default "sem resultado"

logger.doc:name: After MCP tool call
logger.doc:description: Logs AFTER_REQUEST once the MCP tool has responded

ee:transform.doc:name: Append tool result
ee:transform.doc:description: Appends the MCP tool result as a Responses API function_call_output keyed by call_id

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- vars.toolResults ++ [{ 'type': 'function_call_output', call_id: vars.currentCall.call_id, 'output': vars.toolOutput }]

ee:transform.doc:name: Build OpenAI request (final answer)
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds the second OpenAI request, appending the assistant message and tool results

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { model: p('config.openai.model'), previous_response_id: vars.openaiResponseId, 'input': vars.toolResults }

logger.doc:name: Before OpenAI call 2
logger.doc:description: Logs BEFORE_REQUEST before the second OpenAI call (final answer)

http:request.doc:name: OpenAI final answer
http:request.doc:description: Calls OpenAI Responses API again with the tool results to produce the final answer

logger.doc:name: After OpenAI call 2
logger.doc:description: Logs AFTER_REQUEST once OpenAI has returned the final answer

set-variable.value: #[((payload.'output' default []) filter ($.'type' == 'message'))[0].content[0].text default 'Nao consegui processar a solicitacao.']
set-variable.doc:name: Set finalAnswer
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the OpenAI final answer text for the A2A response

otherwise.doc:name: No tools requested
otherwise.doc:description: Uses the assistant message directly when OpenAI requested no tools

set-variable.doc:name: Set finalAnswer (no tools)
set-variable.doc:description: Stores the assistant content, or a fallback message when none is present

ee:transform.doc:name: Build A2A task response
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds the completed A2A 1.0 task response with the final answer as message and artifact

logger.doc:name: Flow end
logger.doc:description: Logs END tracePoint with the completed taskId
logger.message: #[output application/json --- {message: 'A2A task completed', tracePoint: 'END'} ++ ({ taskId: vars.taskId })]

logger.doc:name: Log agent error
logger.doc:description: Logs EXCEPTION tracePoint with the error type and description on any failure

ee:transform.doc:name: Build A2A failed task
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds a failed A2A task response carrying a friendly error message back to the caller
